text: It starts like any other swap.
Right URL. Green padlock. Audited contracts. Everything looks normal.
But the domain was just hijacked. Same address. Different code.
One click. Unlimited approval. $1.2 million, gone.
Every warning sign was there. Nobody was checking.
This is BOUND. Know where your signature is going — before you sign.
BOUND asks two questions. Is this site acting differently? Is this action authorized here?
Same hijack. Unknown spender. Fresh DNS change. Escalated in milliseconds — and your wallet never sees it.
Trust is anchored in ENS and Swarm, watched live on Arkiv. Hijackers can't forge it.
BOUND warns. Never blocks. Protects the very first victim.
BOUND. Trust what you connect to.
